slides.title: Introduction: Why Advanced Prompting?
content: If you're not a coder, this is your single most important skill for using AI.
Think of an AI model like an incredibly smart, fast, and knowledgeable intern.
It can do amazing things, but it needs very specific instructions.
Prompting is the art and science of giving those instructions to get the high-quality results you want.
narration: Welcome!
If you are not a coder, advanced prompting is vital.
It is your most important skill for using AI.
Think of an AI model as a smart, fast, and knowledgeable intern.
It can do amazing things for you.
However, it needs very specific instructions.
Prompting is the art of giving those instructions.
It is a science to get the high-quality results you want.
Let's dive in!
slides.image_prompt: An enthusiastic intern with a graduation cap, sitting at a desk with a computer showing AI symbols, ready to receive instructions.

slides.title: The Anatomy of a Good Prompt: The 3 C's Revisited
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer. A great prompt gets a great answer.
The best prompts almost always include three key ingredients: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
narration: We have previously introduced the 3 Cs.
Let's quickly revisit them now.
They form the foundation for good prompts.
Remember, a weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt will get a great answer.
The best prompts include three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
slides.image_prompt: A graphic showcasing three interlocking gears labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', and 'Constraints', with 'Great Output' as the result.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking. Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
Good Prompt (Clear): 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
narration: First, Clarity. Be specific!
The AI cannot read your mind.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
For example, 'Write about electric cars' is a weak prompt.
A clear prompt is: 'Write a short blog post.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
Target someone living in a city.'
slides.image_prompt: Split screen: left shows a person with a confused expression next to a generic AI response; right shows a person smiling with a focused, helpful AI response.

slides.title: C2: Context - Give it Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking and who the audience is. It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
narration: Next, Context. Give the AI background information!
Context tells the AI why you are asking.
It also reveals who the audience is.
This helps the AI adopt the correct perspective.
Our previous good prompt was: 'Write a short blog post.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
Target someone living in a city.'
With context, it becomes: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog.
This blog focuses on sustainable living.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
Target someone living in a city.'
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison of two AI outputs: one generic, one tailored to 'sustainable living lifestyle blog'.

slides.title: C3: Constraints - Set the Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output. Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
Better Prompt: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'
narration: Finally, Constraints. Set the rules for the AI!
Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
Our better prompt was: 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog.
This blog focuses on sustainable living.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
Target someone living in a city.'
An excellent prompt with constraints adds more rules.
It becomes: 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words.
Target a lifestyle blog focused on sustainable living.
Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car.
Target someone living in a city.
Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone.
End with a question to encourage comments.'
slides.image_prompt: A graphic representation of a prompt with various 'rule' icons (word count, tone, call to action) around it, leading to a perfectly shaped output.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: This is a super-powerful trick. Tell the AI who to be.
Prompt: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
narration: Here is a bonus tip: provide a persona!
This is a super-powerful trick.
Tell the AI who to be.
For instance: 'Act as an expert travel agent.
Specialize in budget travel.
Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome.
It is for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
This helps the AI tailor its response.
It will use a specific voice and knowledge.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot wearing a detective hat, then a chef's hat, then a doctor's coat, showing its ability to adopt different personas.

slides.title: Giving Examples: Zero, One, and Few-Shot Prompting
content: This sounds technical, but it's simple. It's about whether you give the AI an example to follow.
Zero-Shot: You give zero examples. Most prompts are like this. You just ask for what you want. (All our examples above are zero-shot).
One-Shot: You give one example to show the AI the pattern you want. This is great for specific formatting.
Few-Shot: You give a few examples to teach the AI a more complex pattern.
narration: Now, let's talk about giving examples.
These are Zero, One, and Few-Shot Prompting.
This sounds technical, but it is simple.
It is about whether you give the AI an example to follow.
Zero-shot means you give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
One-shot means you give one example.
This shows the AI a specific pattern.
It is great for formatting.
Few-shot means you give a few examples.
This teaches the AI a more complex pattern.
slides.image_prompt:
A visual metaphor: three distinct paths 
 one with no guide (zero-shot), one with a single signpost (one-shot), and one with multiple guideposts (few-shot).

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting Example
content: Summarize text into key points like this:
Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.'
Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'
Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]
narration: Here is an example of one-shot prompting.
You would tell the AI: 'Summarize text into key points like this:
Text: 'The sun is a star, and it is the center of our solar system.'
Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'.
Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here].
This clearly demonstrates the desired output format.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of an AI chat interface showing the one-shot prompt and its expected formatted output.

slides.title: Advanced Prompting Techniques
content: Ready to elevate your prompting game? Let's explore some advanced techniques.
1. Chain-of-Thought (CoT): Asking the AI to 'Think Step-by-Step'
2. Structuring the Output: Tell it the Format You Need
3. Iterative Prompting: It's a Conversation!
narration: Ready to elevate your prompting game?
Let's explore some truly advanced techniques.
We will cover Chain-of-Thought prompting.
We will also discuss structuring the output to your exact needs.
Finally, we will explore the powerful concept of iterative prompting.
slides.image_prompt: A graphic of a complex brain-like network with glowing connections, indicating advanced thought processes and structured output.

slides.title: Chain-of-Thought (CoT): 'Think Step-by-Step'
content: For problems involving logic, math, or reasoning, this technique is magical.
By simply adding the phrase 'think step-by-step' or 'show your reasoning,' you force the model to lay out its logic, which dramatically reduces errors.
Prompt: 'I have 5 boxes of apples. Each box has 12 apples. I eat 3 apples and give away one full box. How many apples are left? Think step-by-step.'
narration: First, Chain-of-Thought, or CoT.
This is magical for problems involving logic, math, or reasoning.
By adding phrases like 'think step-by-step' or 'show your reasoning,' you help the model.
It forces the model to lay out its logic.
This dramatically reduces errors.
For example: 'I have 5 boxes of apples.
Each box has 12 apples.
I eat 3 apples and give away one full box.
How many apples are left? Think step-by-step.'
slides.image_prompt: A flowchart graphic illustrating a problem-solving process with decision points and a final correct answer, emphasizing 'step-by-step' thinking.

slides.title: Structuring the Output: Tell it the Format You Need
content: Don't just ask for information; tell the AI how to organize it. This saves you tons of time.
Prompt: 'List the pros and cons of remote work. Provide the output as a Markdown table with two columns: 'Pros' and 'Cons'.'
You can ask for formats like: A numbered list, HTML code, JSON, A simple comma-separated list.
narration: Next, structuring the output.
Do not just ask for information.
Tell the AI exactly how to organize it.
This saves you tons of time.
For example: 'List the pros and cons of remote work.
Provide the output as a Markdown table.
Use two columns: 'Pros' and 'Cons'.'
You can ask for various formats.
These include numbered lists, HTML code, or JSON.
You can also ask for a simple comma-separated list.
slides.image_prompt: A digital screen showing a clear, well-formatted Markdown table generated by AI, contrasting with a messy, unformatted text block.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting: It's a Conversation!
content: Your first prompt is rarely your last. The real skill is in refining your prompts based on the AI's output. Treat it like a conversation.
You: 'Write a slogan for my new coffee shop.'
AI: 'Brewing Happiness, One Cup at a Time.'
You: 'That's good, but can you make it shorter and more modern?'
AI: 'Urban Brews. Your Daily Grind.'
You: 'Perfect!'
narration: Finally, iterative prompting.
Remember, your first prompt is rarely your last.
The real skill is refining your prompts.
Base this on the AI's output.
Treat it like a conversation.
You might start with: 'Write a slogan for my new coffee shop.'
The AI will respond.
Then you can refine: 'That is good, but can you make it shorter and more modern?'
The AI then provides an improved answer.
This back-and-forth interaction leads to the best results.
slides.image_prompt: Two cartoon characters (one human, one AI robot) having a friendly, collaborative chat bubble conversation, showing prompt and refinement.

slides.title: Practical Lab: Your Turn!
content: Now it's time to practice. Open up a tool like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude.
Text Generation Challenge: Combine a Persona, the 3 C's, and a Structured Output.
Try this prompt:

'Act as a fitness coach. Create a simple 3-day workout plan for a beginner who wants to exercise at home with no equipment. The goal is a full-body workout. Present it in a table format with columns for 'Day', 'Exercise', and 'Duration'.'
narration: Now it is time to practice!
Open up a tool like Google Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude.
Let's try a text generation challenge.
Combine a persona, the 3 Cs, and structured output.
Use this prompt: 'Act as a fitness coach.
Create a simple 3-day workout plan.
It is for a beginner who wants to exercise at home.
They should use no equipment.
The goal is a full-body workout.
Present it in a table format.
Use columns for 'Day', 'Exercise', and 'Duration'.'

slides.title: Image Prompting Introduction & Challenge
content: Image tools like Midjourney or DALL-E 3 use the same principles but focus on visual details. Be descriptive! Think like an artist.
Image Prompt Challenge:
'A close-up, photorealistic image of a cat wearing a tiny detective hat and magnifying glass, sitting in a library. The lighting is warm and cinematic.'
Start experimenting! The more you practice, the better you'll get. You now have the fundamental skills to get amazing results from any AI tool.
narration: Finally, an introduction to image prompting.
Tools like Midjourney or DALL-E 3 use the same principles.
However, they focus on visual details.
Be descriptive! Think like an artist.
Try this image prompt challenge.
Prompt: 'A close-up, photorealistic image of a cat.
The cat wears a tiny detective hat and magnifying glass.
It sits in a library.
The lighting is warm and cinematic.'
Start experimenting!
The more you practice, the better you will get.
You now have the fundamental skills.
You can get amazing results from any AI tool.
